findings.title: Demo/Live gate never appears after Delete All
findings.detail: JUST_WORKS_DEMO_PENDING_KEY is session-only. Reload/SW death after JustWorks drops demoChoice. siteDisconnected is also resolved before demoChoice, so a disconnected X host hides the gate even if the flag is set.

findings.title: Delete All clears allowedDomains but keeps xHostOneTimeAutoConnectDone
findings.detail: Route becomes siteDisconnected. One-time auto-connect will not run again. User must click Connect site. Observed after DELETE_USER_DATA mode=all.

findings.title: Delete All + JustWorks restores the Chrome Easy blob, not a new key
findings.detail: Same npub npub1dyse7tsgw4d / pubkey 69219f2e… came back as never-lock vault, localBound, skipping a true empty-key first install.

findings.title: After wipe+reload, service worker chrome.tabs.create timed out for 15s+
findings.detail: AXI could not open popup/cockpit until ax go. Product SW may be dead or not accepting tabs.create after DELETE_USER_DATA.

findings.title: Elon Notes shows outgoing-trust unavailable while Trusts list is populated
findings.detail: Copy: 'Outgoing trust is unavailable until this account is linked to a Nostr key.' Trusts tab still listed SpaceX and others. Conflicts with docs/demo-wot.md.

findings.title: Home demo chain chips omit NASA (4°)
findings.detail: Visible chips: Elon 1°, Tesla 3°, SpaceX 2°. NASA appears in Elon statements (50%) but not the home chain list.

findings.title: Elon Trusted-by list duplicates NASA, SpaceX, Tesla, operator
findings.detail: Each of those subjects appeared twice with the same trust percent.

findings.title: Add Account after key clear hides Easy/browser restore
findings.detail: WizardOverlay passes hasAccounts=canClose. User-initiated wizard hides Easy CTA. AfterKeyClear only offers Email/Password and Advanced. Hint points at Settings → Browser Account Roaming.

findings.title: GET_OPERATOR_X_BINDINGS still reports bound after vault destroy
findings.detail: Route afterKeyClear, vault.kind=absent, hasIdentity=false, binding.kind=remoteOnly, but bindings[0].bound=true.

findings.title: Home Demo toggle seeds local WoT
findings.detail: 414 demo events, 68 X identities, named Elon/Tesla/SpaceX chips, Impersonate/Path/Graph on Elon Notes.

findings.title: Home timeline chips and chip popover work
findings.detail: AXI x posts showed author-trust + post-rating chrome; x chip @c1 opened trust UI.

findings.title: Application pages load
findings.detail: users, events (414 cached), outbox, log, danger, admin. Users show named X chrome.

findings.title: Delete keys lands on afterKeyClear with Add Account
findings.detail: lifecycle=keysCleared, vault absent. Wizard method step opens (credential + advanced).
